description: This is a Java test class for the COBBulkEventConfiguration, testing the behavior of event recording during COB (Charge Order Batch) process execution in different configurations and exception scenarios. It uses Mockito and JUnit 5 for mocking and testing, verifying interaction with the BusinessEventNotifierService based on configuration settings.

classes.name: COBBulkEventConfigurationTest
classes.description: Test class for COBBulkEventConfiguration, verifying event recording behavior during COB execution with different configurations and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes thread-local context and mocks dependencies before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testGivenBulkEventEnabledWhenCOBRunThenEventsAreRecorded
methods.description: Verifies that event recording starts and stops when bulk event is enabled and COB run is executed successfully.

methods.name: testGivenBulkEventDisabledWhenCOBRunThenEventsAreNotRecorded
methods.description: Verifies that event recording does not start or stop when bulk event is disabled.

methods.name: testGivenBulkEventEnabledWhenCOBRunExceptionThenEventRecordingReset
methods.description: Verifies that event recording is reset when an exception occurs during COB run with bulk event enabled.

methods.name: testGivenBulkEventDisabledWhenCOBRunExceptionThenEventRecordingResetNotCalled
methods.description: Verifies that resetEventRecording is not called when an exception occurs during COB run with bulk event disabled.
